messages.subject: Error in registerTwitterOAuth(m_oauth) using Shiny
parts:
I am trying to build an app using Shiny and tWitteR package for R.

Up until now I was using RStudio and performing manual runs incl. handshake using my_ouauth

Now i want to leverage the use of Shiny to show some interesting viz. like GeoTagging,FrequencyPlots,Twitter Timeline etc.

I tried to replicate some of the examples/demo in the leaflet-shiny package by jcheng5 to get a feel of how shiny works.

My first concern is :

   How do I ensure manual entering of PIN is not required for my_oauth$handshake ?
   Can this be done in the server.R
   I did try  saving and then loading my_oauth as explained in the earlier post :
   But the error returned was 
  
   > registerTwitterOAuth(my_oauth)
  Error in registerTwitterOAuth(my_oauth) : 
  ROAuth is no longer used in favor of httr, please see ?setup_twitter_oauth
  
  

Any code snippet(where and how this needs to be passed) would be really helpful.
